rationale: TextShaper's multi-line metrics now take each SkParagraph line's own height and the max ascent, descent and leading over all lines, through a new public pure function paragraph_text_extents. Single-style single-line text measures exactly as before; only multi-line text whose later lines resolve a taller fallback face gets taller extents. Pulp continues to own this canvas target under the 2026-10-04 design-import refactor inheritance decision; Vellum inherits the rule when that target adopts the Vellum package. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, packaging or source-authority boundary moves.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'Paragraph extents take a taller later line'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SkParagraph reports LineMetrics fHeight per line'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'TextShaper multiline metrics enclose each line shaped alone'
